设计意图： This mutation preserves the core idea of combining directional pressure (order imbalance) with volume abnormality, but uses shorter 10-day windows and a volume ratio instead of z-score to reduce noise and improve responsiveness, targeting improved RankIC and ICIR while maintaining interpretability.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

OI_10 * (vol_ratio * norm_range), where OI_10 = sum_{i=t-9}^{t}(CLV_i * vol_i), vol_ratio = vol/vol_ma_10, norm_range = (high-low)/close
依赖列: high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

OI_10 * (vol_ratio * norm_range), where OI_10 = sum_{i=t-9}^{t}(CLV_i * vol_i), vol_ratio = vol/vol_ma_10, norm_range = (high-low)/close
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_sum(multiply(where((subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow) != 0), divide(subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), 0), Volume), 10), multiply(divide(Volume, add(ts_mean(Volume, 10), 1e-08)), divide(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), add(AdjClose, 1e-08))))
  2. 2. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum(multiply(where((subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow) != 0), divide(subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), 0), Volume), 10)
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(where((subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow) != 0), divide(subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), 0), Volume)
  4. 4. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow) != 0), divide(subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)), 0)
  5. 5. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow), subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow))
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh), AdjLow)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(multiply(2, AdjClose), AdjHigh)
  9. 9. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(2, AdjClose)
  10. 10. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  11. 11. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(Volume, add(ts_mean(Volume, 10), 1e-08)), divide(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), add(AdjClose, 1e-08)))
  12. 12. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, add(ts_mean(Volume, 10), 1e-08))
  13. 13. add —— 加法
    add(ts_mean(Volume, 10), 1e-08)
  14. 14. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 10)
  15. 15. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), add(AdjClose, 1e-08))
  16. 16. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  17. 17. add —— 加法
    add(AdjClose, 1e-08)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 clv：np.where(high - low != 0
  2. 计算 money_flow：clv * volume
  3. 计算 order_imbalance：money_flow.rolling(window=10, min_periods=1).sum()
  4. 计算 vol_ma：volume.rolling(window=10, min_periods=5).mean()
  5. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / (vol_ma + 1e-8)
  6. 计算 norm_range：(high - low) / (close + 1e-8)
  7. 计算 vol_abnormality：vol_ratio * norm_range
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_imbalance_volume_mutation(df): df_copy = df.copy() clv = np.where(df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] != 0, (2*df_copy["str">'close'] - df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low']) / (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low']), 0) money_flow = clv * df_copy["str">'volume'] order_imbalance = money_flow.rolling(window=10, min_periods=1).sum() vol_ma = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(window=10, min_periods=5).mean() vol_ratio = df_copy["str">'volume'] / (vol_ma + 1e-8) norm_range = (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low']) / (df_copy["str">'close'] + 1e-8) vol_abnormality = vol_ratio * norm_range df_copy["str">'factor_imbalance_volume_mutation'] = order_imbalance * vol_abnormality "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_imbalance_volume_mutation']
